Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the edges lean blue-grey and follow the snow material rather than forming a black sticker line. Texture is modest. That is comparable to the paving reference's 7 raw colours, and the visible-tone count is above both references. It is simple and low-contrast, but it is not flat or sticker-like, so it passes narrowly.
